messages:
Lina Chen: Hey team :wave: I'm Lina, started today in Sales. I'm stuck on getting CRM/Gong/Outreach access — created the IDP request but still missing HubSpot seat and Gong recording. Also can't find the one-pager templates or our objection-handling snippets. Who should I ping for each? Thanks!

Priya Patel: @Lina welcome! :tada: For HubSpot/Salesforce seats ping identity @ops-bot if request stuck. If you used the new hire form, send me your employee ID and I'll check. HubSpot seat name is 'Redwood Sales - HubSpot Pro'. Email me the request link.

Lina Chen: thanks!! employee id 89721 and here's the IDP link: https://idp.redwood.ai/requests/54321

ops-bot: Your IDP request 54321 is in "pending" state. Estimated approval ETA: 1 business day. If urgent, @Priya can escalate.

Priya Patel: I bumped it. Also for Gong, we need your email added to the Gong group 'Sales - Reps'. If you don't get invites in 30m, DM me.

Carlos Ruiz: For call scripts and objection snippets check the Sales playbook under: https://docs.redwood.ai/sales/playbook-v2. One-pagers are in the Marketing drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/sales/collateral (look in 'product one-pagers' folder). TL;DR: we use the 2-slide prospect + discovery template.

Ash Walker: Ping me for Outreach sequences and templates. We have two sequence buckets: 'Outbound - AEs' and 'Inbound - SDR->AE'. If you need shared mailbox access for calls, say so.

Lina Chen: @Ash yep need Outreach and access to the shared mailbox sales-inbox@redwood.ai

Jordan Lee: FYI, for SFDC permissions the permission set you'll need is `Sales_Rep_Standard`. If you ever need to check via CLI: ```sfdx force:org:display -u username@example.com``` (internal note).

Priya Patel: Quick checklist I used when onboarding new reps:
- IDP request submitted
- HubSpot seat granted
- Salesforce permission set applied (Sales_Rep_Standard)
- Gong group invite
- Outreach seat + mailbox
- Slack channels: #sales, #sales-deck-review, #deals-ops
I'll paste the internal onboarding doc after this thread.

Lina Chen: All right, thanks everyone. One last Q: who owns the playbook updates? I found a typo on page 4.

Carlos Ruiz: @Lina that's me for playbook content — open a PR on the doc or drop changes in #sales-deck-review and tag me. :+1: 

Priya Patel: Done — HubSpot and SFDC seats are active. You should have emails now.

Lina Chen: I got them! Gong invite incoming. :rocket: 

ops-bot: Gong invite sent to lchen@redwood.ai

Ash Walker: Outreach invite sent and shared mailbox granted. Welcome aboard! :confetti_ball: 

Lina Chen: big thanks everyone :heart:
